prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1228; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the collision described above. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, to this office and not to our client. Our client has been advised not to discuss the incident or the injuries sustained with any representative of your company without counsel present.

The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, yet our client sustained injuries that required medical treatment and are expected to necessitate further care. We ask that you provide the full policy limits of liability coverage applicable to the at-fault driver, together with a certified copy of the declarations page, within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

Please preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes vehicle damage photographs, repair and total-loss estimates, event data recorder information, telematics or dashcam footage, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and all communications with any party involved. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later proceeding. We look forward to your prompt response.
